themes.label: AI named among green-startup innovations
themes.definition: AI is mentioned in passing as one of several technologies used by green startups, within a narrative about the green industrial revolution, without further AI discussion.
themes.inclusion: Include passages where AI appears only as an illustrative item in a list of innovations or breakthroughs.
themes.exclusion: Exclude passages that develop an argument specifically about AI's climate or economic role.
themes.boundary_cases: If the passage explained how AI specifically improves climate outcomes, code AI_DEVELOPMENT_SDGS instead.

examples.quote: using artificial intelligence and robotics to enhance food production, capture carbon dioxide

themes.label: AI for food production and climate
themes.definition: AI presented as an enabling technology for climate solutions and food production within green growth.
themes.inclusion: Include mentions of AI applied to climate, agriculture, or green economic transformation.
themes.boundary_cases: When the mention is a single list item, code both this and AI_TECH_LIST_MENTION.

examples.quote: artificial intelligence and robotics to enhance food production

value.rationale: The single UK 2021 passage is about green investment and jobs; AI appears only as a passing example of green-startup innovation in food production and carbon capture.
